headline: **MLB Daily Recap: May 22, 2026**
article:
The Houston Astros secured a 4-2 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Christian Vázquez leading the offense and Spencer Arrighetti pitching a strong 5.0 innings. The Cleveland Guardians shut down the Philadelphia Phillies 1-0, with Gavin Williams pitching 8.0 innings of shutout baseball and Kyle Manzardo leading the Guardians' offense with a solo home run. The Tampa Bay Rays took down the New York Yankees 4-2, with Austin Wells leading the offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Mickey Moniak (Colorado Rockies) with right ankle tendonitis, Jung Hoo Lee (San Francisco Giants) with a mid-back strain, Burch Smith (Detroit Tigers) with right shoulder inflammation, Ke'Bryan Hayes (Cincinnati Reds) with a lumbar bulging disc, Yoán Moncada (Los Angeles Angels) with right knee inflammation, and Yusei Kikuchi (Los Angeles Angels) with left shoulder inflammation.

The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for cash, while the Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley. The Tampa Bay Rays traded LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn, and the Toronto Blue Jays traded LHP Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash.

top_news.title: **Guardians Shut Down Phillies in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 1-0 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Gavin Williams pitching 8.0 innings of shutout baseball, striking out 11 batters and allowing 4 hits. Kyle Manzardo led the Guardians' offense with a solo home run.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Yankees 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 4-2 victory over the New York Yankees, with Austin Wells leading the offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays defeated the Pittsburgh Pirates 6-2, securing their win. Kevin Gausman earned the win for the Blue Jays, while Louis Varland recorded the save.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Lead in Thrilling Tiebreaker**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged out the Tampa Bay Rays in a 0-0 final, securing a crucial win in their matchup.

top_news.title: **Rockies Place Mickey Moniak on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies left fielder Mickey Moniak has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to right ankle tendonitis.

top_news.title: **Phillies Make Roster Move Ahead of Sunday's Game**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies made a trade on Saturday, May 22, sending RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies in exchange for cash.
